info.description: Generated by python scripts/export_api.py from the runtime OpenAPI. Import the blank environment template, set local credentials, and send login. Cookies are managed by the client; mutations send X-CSRF-Token. Re-login whenever changing roles. This is a request library, not a run-all suite. Checkout retains its idempotency key for retries; clear it for a new order. See docs/API_CLIENT.md and docs/ACCEPTANCE_HANDOFF.md.
